newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ registered unemployed rises in Nov - McCardle.
newsitem.headline: NZ registered unemployed rises in Nov - McCardle.

text.p: The number of people registered as unemployed rose in November, new Employment Minister Peter McCardle announced on Thursday.
McCardle said 159,144 people were registered as unemployed in November, an increase of 5238 over October's number.
While he was disappointed with the rise, unemployment traditionally increased in November and December as students completed their studies and entered the job market.
The official measure of unemployment is the quarterly Household Labour Force Survey, which on latest figures shows unemployment standing at 6.3 percent of the workforce.
